name.description: The exact SourcedPackage.name on that source.

severity.description: "warning" for a real functional problem, "info" for a lesser one with a confirmed one-line fix.

issue.description: What actually goes wrong, in plain terms.

fix.description: A concrete workaround, when one exists — omit entirely rather than leaving empty when there's no known fix.

reason.description: How this was verified (issue trackers, forum reports, ...) — required so the warning is auditable later, not just an unexplained line.

title: Enrich: compatibility warnings
description: Known packaging-format compatibility issues for one specific app on one specific source (e.g. GNOME Boxes via Snap losing KVM/libvirt device access to confinement) — surfaced in app's install drawer next to the affected source, not a separate page.
